claim: This branch determines the true value of H0 or resolves the Hubble tension.
The observed posterior differences prove bias, error, or invalidity in gwcosmo, icarogw, DES Y6, GLADE+, a population model, or the GWTC-5 event frame.
The IFAR comparisons are statistically significant, materially biased, or scientifically unacceptable merely because they have the largest audited W1/median shifts.
C11/C12 were successfully preregistered primary comparisons after the Phase5 grid-density conversion.
Branch01/02/05/07 numerical results explain or quantify the H0 shifts observed in Branch08.
The FullPop-versus-MLTP differences isolate population-model dependence; those comparisons are confounded by the 235-CBC versus 231-BBH frame difference.
Modified-gravity, varying-Omega_m or spin-model robustness was audited in this branch.
The public sample summaries exactly reproduce every published headline summary statistic.
These frozen-release findings automatically transport unchanged to a future GWTC/cosmology release.
